description: Takes an observed symptom (warping, stringing, layer separation, elephant's foot, holes in the top surface, ...) and returns an ordered list of remedies, each with its mechanism, a suggested value and its cost. Use it when the user describes what went wrong rather than which parameter to change; apply one remedy at a time. If no known symptom matches, it says so instead of guessing. It also points out problems that no parameter can fix. No side effects.

material.description: The material, e.g. PLA / ABS / PETG / TPU; a material-specific note is returned when one exists.

symptom.description: The symptom in natural language, e.g. "the bottom layer bulges outward" (elephant's foot). Chinese descriptions are matched too.

symptomId.description: A known symptom id; skips text matching.

name: bambu_diagnose
title: Diagnose a print failure from its symptom
